captions.story: Seven miles down, where the water pressure could crush steel, strange life forms thrive in total darkness.

story.series: What Lies at the Bottom of Horizon Deep?
story.summary: This episode explores Horizon Deep in the Tonga Trench, Earth's second deepest point. It highlights extreme ocean pressure, translucent snailfish, giant amphipods, and microbial life thriving on thermal vents.

title: What Lies at the Bottom of Horizon Deep?
